scope: Independent reconstruction of saved poses, source MAT/TRC equality, model/fitting contracts and static calibration; no pipeline, IK solver, dynamic simulation or policy execution.
findings: AB08 static marker locations, units, body mapping, registered ankle pose and ground convention reproduce recorded calibration independently.
Adopted AB08 prosthetic-side mean frame marker RMS is 11.8847mm, comparable to adopted AB06 11.8358mm; the larger overall RMS mainly reflects the right biological side.

The 114.9308mm R_Thigh_Upper residual at56.635s coincides with a123.546mm marker step in5ms and125.281mm return. All exported TRC marker samples match the original dataset MAT; the converter did not introduce the discontinuity.
At that exact time, native healthy AB08 evaluated on its dataset IK also has144.8164mm R_Thigh_Upper residual; the anomaly is independent of the prosthetic calibration.
All marker tasks have unit weight; source marker outliers propagate to the solved IK, including impulses in right hip coordinates and pelvis translations.
Descriptive removal of high-error frames barely changes the AB08 global mean RMS (11.998mm to11.966mm); source outliers explain transient peaks but not the persistent mean error.
limitations: Static fit uses calibration samples, not independent physical measurement of true prosthetic geometry or floor.
AB06 comparison reconstructs residuals from its adopted full model/IK/TRC; no matching full native error companion is available. AB07/08 reconstruction agrees with their native diagnostics.
No dynamic/contact/event/online GRF qualification was performed.
No marker samples, fitting parameters, SEA/controller parameters or adopted IK were changed; robust marker preprocessing and IK quality acceptance require a subsequent implementation decision.
